# Backend / API Layer

> This repo is a **frontend-only SPA**. There is no server-side code here.
> "Backend" in this context means the API client layer that talks to the separate NMI .NET backend.

## API Client

All backend communication goes through a single auto-generated file:

```text
ClientApp/src/api/web-api-client.ts   (386 symbols — NSwag/OpenAPI generated)
```

**Do not edit this file directly.** Regenerate from the OpenAPI spec when the backend contract changes.

## API Surface (selected operations by domain)

| Domain | Client class / operation pattern |
|--------|----------------------------------|
| Account | `AccountClient` — create, update, get, branches |
| Contact | `ContactClient` — create, update |
| Request For Quote | `RequestForQuoteClient` — create, copy, get, submit |
| Type Approval | `TypeApprovalClient` — create, get, manage, submit |
| Accept Quote | `AcceptQuoteClient` — create, submit |
| Quotation | `QuotationClient` — get |
| Measurement Report | `MeasurementReportClient` — list, get |
| Lookup | `LookupClient` — address, organisation name auto-suggest |

## Auth → API Token Flow

```text
MSAL → AccountProvider → silentRequest.ts → access token in headers
     ↓
each API call: Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

`ClientApp/src/authentication/silentRequest.ts` — builds the MSAL silent-token request scope.

## Environment Config

API base URL and other config is injected at runtime via `window.*`:

```ts
import { env } from '../env';
env.REACT_APP_API_URL  // correct — from window injection
process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL  // WRONG — undefined at runtime
```

See `ClientApp/src/env.ts` for the full list of runtime variables.
